description.p: Jorvik is a Matrix client that arranges a homeserver the way a chat app should feel: Spaces are servers, rooms are channels, and end-to-end encryption is on by default.
It talks to any Matrix homeserver, so conversations are not tied to one provider, and it can be pointed at a server you run yourself.

ul.li: Spaces and channels, with nested subspaces
End-to-end encrypted messages and encrypted media
Voice channels, and calls from a profile
Desktop notifications and an unread badge on the tray icon

description.p: Verification with other Matrix apps works, and a batch of new features.

ul.li: Your account gets cross-signing, so Element and other apps can verify it with your security key
Call someone from their profile, and invite them to a server or channel
Do Not Disturb, and an automatic Idle status
Block and report people, and delete a server
A Flatpak build, and AppImage updates in place

description.p: The right panel is remembered separately for direct messages and servers.
Fixes encryption in direct messages, and a one-to-one conversation shows the other person's profile.
